gatoh.graphs.GraphSet.load_edge

GraphSet.load_edge(edge_dir: str, edge_file: str) → tuple[GraphEdge, int][source]

A helper function that allows for multithreading within load_graphset_multi().

Parameters:

  • edge_dir (str) – The root directory where all graph edges have been saved.

  • edge_file (str) – The name of the pickle file that is being loaded.

Returns:

The unpickled graph edge object and its corresponding index in the graph.

Return type:

tuple[GraphEdge, int]
